description.value: Fireside Grill occupies a lovingly restored heritage Tudor estate—originally Maltwood Manor, built in the 1930s—set among wild Garry oak trees and manicured gardens about 10 minutes from Victoria's downtown core. The restaurant has earned multiple Readers' Choice awards from the Victoria Times Colonist for Best Fine Dining, Best Brunch, Best Patio, and Best Happy Hour, making it a well-regarded local institution. A touring cyclist arriving here will find a full farm-to-table menu, weekend brunch, patio seating, and event spaces in a distinctly Victorian setting.

address.value: 4509 West Saanich Road, Victoria, BC, V8Z 5L3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides strong evidence. Takeout is confirmed by the 'TAKEOUT' navigation link, prominent 'order takeout' call-to-action, and 'Take Out' menu section. Gluten-friendly items are confirmed by '(GF)' labels on multiple menu items; a tofu add-on suggests vegetarian options. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, charging, or water refill anywhere on the site. A postal code discrepancy exists: OSM lists V8Z 3G1 while the website consistently shows V8Z 5L3.
